'''2019 Match Play Championship''' was the Players Committee match-play championship, April 2019. [[Chris Kelly]] finished 1st in the Final Four.<ref name="pc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2019-match-play-championships/ starwarsccg.org], starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013162035/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2019-match-play-championships.html Internet Archive].</ref> [[Trevor Partridge]] won the consolation bracket.<ref name="yt-mpc2019">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=88-rZP-hBMA MPC 2019 Interview: Consolation Winner Trevor Partridge], Star Wars CCG (Players Committee YouTube, 1 May 2019). Overlay: Trevor Partridge Consolation Bracket Champion.</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' United States
* '''Dates:''' 26–28 April 2019<ref name="slack-mpc19-dates">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, Players Committee Twitter feed (@swccg), 26–28 April 2019: “SWCCG Players... Welcome to the 2019 Match Play Championship. We have started tonite with the Team Tournament.”; “Chris Kelly wins the 2019 MPC!! Congratulations.”</ref>

[[Chris Gogolen]], [[Stephen Cellucci]], [[Lenny Rubin]], Chris Kelly, [[Charlie Arlandson]], [[Brian Fred]] and [[Reid Smith]] were among the players who reached the Elite 8 on 27 April 2019; Brian Fred beat [[Greg Shaw]] and Reid Smith beat [[Keith Brown]] in the last round before it.<ref name="slack-mpc19-e8">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, Players Committee Twitter feed (@swccg), 27 April 2019: “First into the Elite 8 at MPC, newly inducted Hall of Famer, Chris Gogolen.”; “2nd entry into the Elite 8 at MPC is...Stephen Cellucci.”; “Lenny Rubin advances to the Elite 8.”; “Chris Kelly and Charlie Arlandson also advanced to the Elite 8”; “Brian Fred advances in the featured match over Greg Shaw... Reid Smith Advances over Keith Brown.”</ref> Gogolen, [[Tom Kelly]] and Fred advanced to the Final Four that evening.<ref name="slack-mpc19-f4">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, Players Committee Twitter feed (@swccg), 27 April 2019: “Chris Gogolen Advances to the Final Four tomorrow!”; “Tom Kelly Advances to the Final Four tomorrow!”; “Brian Fred Advances to the Final Four Tomorrow.”</ref> On 28 April, Tom Kelly and Chris Kelly won their semifinals, and Chris Kelly beat Tom Kelly in the final after Tom won the first game by 2.<ref name="slack-mpc19-final">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, Players Committee Twitter feed (@swccg), 28 April 2019: “Tom Kelly and Chris Kelly advance to the MPC Finals”; “Tom Kelly wins Game 1. +2.”; “Chris Kelly wins the 2019 MPC!!”</ref>

== Side events ==

* '''Team tournament''' (26 April 2019): won by [[Brian Fred]] and [[Mike Kessling]].<ref name="slack-mpc19-team">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, Players Committee Twitter feed (@swccg), 26 April 2019: “Brian Fred and Mike Kessling win The Team Tournament.”</ref>
* '''Hall of Fame:''' [[Chris Gogolen]] was a newly inducted Hall of Famer at the event.<ref name="slack-mpc19-e8" />
* '''Consolation bracket''' (28 April 2019): [[Ming Huo]] and [[Eric Hunter]] were in its Final Four. [[Trevor Partridge]] beat [[Jared Napolitano]] in the final, his second consolation bracket win.<ref name="slack-mpc19-cons">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, Players Committee Twitter feed (@swccg), 28 April 2019: “Ming Huo Final Four Participant- consolation bracket.”; “Eric Hunter Final Four participant- Consolation Bracket.”; “Trevor Partridge wins the Consolation Bracket Final. (his 2nd such Victory)”; “Trevor Partridge and Jared Napolitano. 1st and 2nd place in the Consolation Bracket Final.”</ref>
* '''Day 3 consolation event''' (28 April 2019): [[Joe Olson]] reached its championship match.<ref name="slack-mpc19-d3">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, Players Committee Twitter feed (@swccg), 28 April 2019: “Day 3 Consolation event, Joe Olson moves onto the championship match!”</ref>
